scope.question: Can the first PMXT Polymarket L2 proof proceed without proving dynamic tick-size replay?
scope.answer: Yes, only for a bounded first proof whose source-proof instrument universe explicitly excludes instruments with tick_size_change rows in the object window and records claim limits. This does not close full PMXT Polymarket L2 acceptance or broad backfill.

nt_path_assessment.finding: BacktestNode loads catalog instruments before market data and does not pass run start/end into query_instruments_filtered.
BacktestNode catalog replay feeds market data into BacktestEngine::add_data as Vec<Data>.
NT Data does not include InstrumentAny instrument-definition updates.
BacktestNode streaming mode preserves engine state across data chunks, but chunks still contain Data enum items and cannot carry InstrumentAny updates.
Multiple BacktestRunConfig entries run separate engines, so epoch splitting through run configs does not preserve one continuous strategy/account state.
Direct BacktestEngine::add_instrument can apply InstrumentAny, but scheduling that between epochs is outside the current BacktestNode catalog-replay path required by this BTE proof.

runtime_code_restrictions: The selector and row budget must come from TOML/source-proof metadata.

claim_limits: This is a selector/source-proof artifact only; it does not project PMXT rows to NT catalog data.
This does not prove nautilus-polymarket parser/provider reuse inside the isolated BTE crate.
This does not prove BacktestNode consumes a selected source-backed PMXT catalog.
This does not authorize broad PMXT backfill.
Does not prove dynamic tick-size replay.
Does not prove assets with tick_size_change rows.
Does not prove full PMXT Polymarket L2 source acceptance.
Does not prove continuous strategy/account state across tick-size epochs.
May prove NT catalog/read-back/BacktestNode plumbing for the selected unaffected instrument universe only.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Pinned NT live handling treats real tick-size changes as instrument epoch transitions and waits for a fresh snapshot before book deltas resume.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Load all instrument snapshots up front
rejected_alternatives.reason: BacktestNode query_instruments loads snapshots before market data; SimulatedExchange inserts by instrument id, so later snapshots can overwrite earlier snapshots before replay starts.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Split epochs into separate BacktestRunConfig entries
rejected_alternatives.reason: BacktestNode creates separate engines per run config, so this does not preserve one continuous strategy/account state.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Manually call BacktestEngine::add_instrument between replay epochs
rejected_alternatives.reason: This uses an NT API but leaves the current BacktestNode catalog-replay proof path and would need a separate design decision before implementation.

required_green_tests_when_implementation: Source-proof ledger computes per-asset event counts without venue or asset constants.
First-proof selector refuses assets with tick_size_change rows.
First-proof selector is deterministic and bounded by configured row budget.
Result contract records excluded tick-change asset/event counts and forbidden full-L2 claims.
BacktestNode proof reads only selected unaffected instruments and data rows from NT ParquetDataCatalog.

current_decision.next_required_evidence: TDD implementation proof for the configured first-proof selector, NT catalog read-back, and BacktestNode run over selected unaffected instruments; dynamic tick-size replay remains a separate blocker for full L2 acceptance.
